headline: Gold and silver steady today; 24K near ₹14,357 per gram
summary: Today's change is zero for gold at all three purities and for silver, so the national rates are unchanged from the previous rate. Over the last 7 days, 24K gold is up 3.38% (₹469), while silver is up 2.5% (₹5,000 per kg), and over the 14 days of history silver is down 6.82% from ₹2,20,000 per kg on 26 October. Gold's high in this period was ₹14,602 on 5 November and its low was ₹13,888 on 31 October; the likely drivers are the US dollar, the rupee and festive or wedding demand, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: With no movement today and recent swings of a few percent, it makes sense to compare rates across jewellers before buying, and to remember that GST and making charges are added on top of these rates.
